capabilities: move files into a newly created folder
move folders into a new parent folder
pick a parent folder from a searchable picker
trigger the move from the command palette or file explorer
default the picker to the active note's parent folder
extras: README states the plugin has no telemetry, network access, accounts, or payments, and that macOS and iOS support is not fully validated. Links to use-case and FAQ docs are listed but their content is not included in the README.
problem: Moving a file into a new folder normally means creating the folder first and then typing or browsing to the destination path.
summary: File manager helper that moves files or folders into a newly created folder via context menu or command palette.
